title: universal camlock and charlock open source
features: a simple lil script that adds two draggable toggles, one locks you camera onto targets humanoid. while the other locks your character instead.
script:
local P = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")

local plr = P.LocalPlayer
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local OffsetU = 0
local OffsetD = 0

local aimOn = false
local charOn = false

local aimTarget = nil
local charTarget = nil

local oldAutoRotate = nil

local offBg = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local onBg = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 243)
local offLine = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 218)
local onLine = Color3.fromRGB(149, 92, 215)
local ink = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 36)

local ui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local popup = Instance.new("Frame")
local popupCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
local popupStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
local popupTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local popupLink = Instance.new("TextLabel")
local okBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
local okCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

ui.Name = "LockUI"
ui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
ui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function()
	ui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not ui.Parent then
	ui.Parent = plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end
popup.Name = "WelcomePopup"
popup.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 180)
popup.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -90)
popup.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26)
popup.BorderSizePixel = 0
popup.ZIndex = 100
popup.Parent = ui
popupCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
popupCorner.Parent = popup
popupStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 55)
popupStroke.Thickness = 1
popupStroke.Parent = popup
popupTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28)
popupTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 18)
popupTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
popupTitle.Text = "hello hi this is made by"
popupTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
popupTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon
popupTitle.TextSize = 20
popupTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
popupTitle.ZIndex = 101
popupTitle.Parent = popup
popupLink.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
popupLink.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 52)
popupLink.BackgroundTransparency = 1
popupLink.Text = "https://scriptblox.com/u/indistiputed"
popupLink.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
popupLink.Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon
popupLink.TextSize = 15
popupLink.TextWrapped = true
popupLink.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
popupLink.ZIndex = 101
popupLink.Parent = popup
okBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 34)
okBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -50, 1, -48)
okBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
okBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
okBtn.Text = "OK"
okBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
okBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Cartoon
okBtn.TextSize = 16
okBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
okBtn.ZIndex = 101
okBtn.Parent = popup
okCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
okCorner.Parent = okBtn

local aimBtn
local aimStroke
local charBtn
local charStroke

local loaded = false

local function makeButton(name, text, y, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("Frame")
	local cr = Instance.new("UICorner")
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	local us = Instance.new("UIScale")

	btn.Name = name
	btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(92, 40)
	btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -112, 1, y)
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = offBg
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.Active = true
	btn.ZIndex = 20
	btn.Parent = ui
	cr.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	cr.Parent = btn
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Color = offLine
	stroke.Parent = btn
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = ink
	label.TextSize = 14
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.ZIndex = 21
	label.Parent = btn
	us.Parent = btn

	local held
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	local conn
	local moved = false

	local function isPress(i)
		return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	end

	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if not isPress(i) then
			return
		end

		held = i
		dragStart = i.Position
		startPos = btn.Position
		moved = false

		if conn then
			conn:Disconnect()
		end

		conn = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(x)
			if x ~= held and x.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
				return
			end

			local d = x.Position - dragStart

			if d.Magnitude > 8 then
				moved = true
			end

			if moved then
				btn.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale,
					startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
					startPos.Y.Scale,
					startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y
				)
			end
		end)
	end)

	btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if not isPress(i) then
			return
		end

		if conn then
			conn:Disconnect()
			conn = nil
		end

		if not moved then
			TS:Create(
				us,
				TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{Scale = 0.92}
			):Play()

			task.delay(0.08, function()
				if us.Parent then
					TS:Create(
						us,
						TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{Scale = 1}
					):Play()
				end
			end)

			callback()
		end

		held = nil
		dragStart = nil
		startPos = nil
		moved = false
	end)

	return btn, stroke
end

local function getTorso(p)
	local char = p and p.Character

	if not char then
		return nil
	end

	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local torso = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
		or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")

	if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not torso then
		return nil
	end

	return torso
end

local function getNearestPlayer()
	local char = plr.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if not root then
		return nil
	end

	local nearest
	local distance = math.huge

	for _, p in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
		if p ~= plr then
			local torso = getTorso(p)

			if torso then
				local d = (root.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude

				if d < distance then
					distance = d
					nearest = p
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return nearest
end

local function setVisual(btn, stroke, state)
	if not btn or not stroke then
		return
	end

	TS:Create(
		btn,
		TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{BackgroundColor3 = state and onBg or offBg}
	):Play()

	TS:Create(
		stroke,
		TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		{Color = state and onLine or offLine}
	):Play()
end

local function toggleAim()
	aimOn = not aimOn

	if aimOn then
		aimTarget = getNearestPlayer()
	else
		aimTarget = nil
	end

	setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, aimOn)
end

local function toggleChar()
	charOn = not charOn

	local char = plr.Character
	local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if charOn then
		charTarget = getNearestPlayer()

		if humanoid then
			oldAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		end
	else
		charTarget = nil

		if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
			humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
		end

		oldAutoRotate = nil
	end

	setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, charOn)
end

local function startSystem()
	aimBtn, aimStroke = makeButton("Aimlock", "Aimlock", -148, toggleAim)
	charBtn, charStroke = makeButton("Charlock", "Charlock", -98, toggleChar)

	RS:BindToRenderStep(
		"LockSystem",
		Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1,
		function()
			cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

			if aimOn then
				local torso = getTorso(aimTarget)

				if not torso then
					aimOn = false
					aimTarget = nil
					setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
				else
					local focus = cam.Focus.Position
					local dist = (cam.CFrame.Position - focus).Magnitude
					local dir = torso.Position - focus

					if dir.Magnitude > 0.1 then
						local cameraPosition =
							focus
							- dir.Unit * dist
							+ Vector3.new(0, OffsetU, 0)
							+ cam.CFrame.RightVector * OffsetD

						cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
							cameraPosition,
							torso.Position
						)
					end
				end
			end

			if charOn then
				local char = plr.Character
				local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local torso = getTorso(charTarget)

				if not root or not torso then
					charOn = false
					charTarget = nil
					setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

					local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
						humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
					end

					oldAutoRotate = nil
				else
					local targetPos = Vector3.new(
						torso.Position.X,
						root.Position.Y,
						torso.Position.Z
					)

					if (targetPos - root.Position).Magnitude > 0.01 then
						root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
							root.Position,
							targetPos
						)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	)

	P.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
		if p == aimTarget then
			aimOn = false
			aimTarget = nil
			setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
		end

		if p == charTarget then
			charOn = false
			charTarget = nil
			setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

			local char = plr.Character
			local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid and oldAutoRotate ~= nil then
				humanoid.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate
			end

			oldAutoRotate = nil
		end
	end)

	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		aimOn = false
		charOn = false
		aimTarget = nil
		charTarget = nil

		setVisual(aimBtn, aimStroke, false)
		setVisual(charBtn, charStroke, false)

		oldAutoRotate = nil
	end)
end

local function loadScript()
	if loaded then
		return
	end

	loaded = true

	popup:Destroy()
	startSystem()

	print("wow bro is loaded look")
end

okBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	okBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 54)
end)

okBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	okBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
end)

okBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	loadScript()
end)
